propositions: The epic-close bug screen degrades all LLM provider failures (including systematic Bedrock 400s) to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating LLMUnavailableError, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor when the provider is degraded
max_tokens configured for a larger model (128K sonnet) is never re-clamped when the resolving model is smaller (64K haiku), causing Bedrock ValidationException on every per-candidate screen call
The completion verifier must fail closed (nonzero exit, in_progress, error naming provider failure) on LLMUnavailableError, consistent with the absent-provider path, instead of degrading open
LLMUnavailableError must be re-raised at both the per-candidate (_row) and advisory (run_screen) seams, while non-systemic failures retain the documented degrade-open behavior
Non-provider per-candidate failures and the --force-close escape hatch must remain unchanged by the fail-closed ruling
